shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- app ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null || true; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null || true; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | head; rg -n 'TextField|Select|Checkbox|Switch|Button|Avatar' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/**/*.d.ts | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; printf '\\n--- entry ---\\n'; node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json'); console.log(p.version,p.types,p.main,p.module,p.exports)\"; printf '\\n--- exports ---\\n'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build"

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in TextField Select Checkbox Switch Button Avatar; do echo "--- $f ---"; rg -n "declare const $f|interface .*Props" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/$f/*.d.ts | head -20; done'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'TextField' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head; echo '---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -iname '*text*'; echo '--- Avatar props ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts; echo '--- Select component ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/Select.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; echo '--- Select types ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts; echo '--- Checkbox ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/ControlProps.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '--- Switch ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts; echo '--- ControlProps ---'; rg -n 'export (interface|type) ControlProps|checked|onChange|onUpdate' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -30; echo '--- Button props ---'; sed -n '1,45p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; echo '--- layout docs? ---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export declare const Select|export \\{ Select\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/*.d.ts | head -10; head -30 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts"
